items.title: Classic Garden Scarecrow
items.alt: A traditional burlap-faced scarecrow is tied to a T-shaped wooden post, wearing a patched plaid shirt, denim overalls and a straw hat with straw projecting from its cuffs.
items.description: A traditional burlap-faced scarecrow is tied to a T-shaped wooden post, wearing a patched plaid shirt, denim overalls and a straw hat with straw projecting from its cuffs. An original scarecrow illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.

items.title: Scarecrow with a Pumpkin Basket
items.alt: A cream-faced scarecrow with closed embroidered eyes and a rust beret kneels in a quilted jacket and green corduroy outfit, holding a pumpkin over a woven harvest basket.
items.description: A cream-faced scarecrow with closed embroidered eyes and a rust beret kneels in a quilted jacket and green corduroy outfit, holding a pumpkin over a woven harvest basket. An original scarecrow illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.

items.title: Scarecrow Reading on a Hay Bale
items.alt: A long-faced linen scarecrow with round reading spectacles and a wool flat cap sits on a hay bale in a teal coat and plum trousers, reading a blue book.

items.title: Scarecrow Painting a Garden Sign
items.alt: A freckled cloth scarecrow in an ochre knitted beanie, lavender painting smock and sage boots paints a pumpkin on a wooden garden sign.
items.description: A freckled cloth scarecrow in an ochre knitted beanie, lavender painting smock and sage boots paints a pumpkin on a wooden garden sign. An original scarecrow illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.

items.title: Scarecrow with a Harvest Wheelbarrow
items.alt: A wooden-faced scarecrow in a black bowler, brick-red waistcoat and striped trousers pushes a wheelbarrow filled with gourds, corn and straw.

items.title: Scarecrow Sewing a Shirt Patch
items.alt: A raffia-haired scarecrow with mismatched sewn eyes wears a plum hat and shoulder cape while stitching a purple patch onto mustard bib trousers.
